detail.longDescription: At this point I am treating every ".*2Shell" "announcement" (1) as an AI industry stunt until I see a reputable, not-AI-pilled security researcher state otherwise. The AI industry can be seen as engaging in a cyberattack on the I and A aspects of the CIA triad when it comes to our understanding of software systems they target with their stunts. Integrity and Availability, often neglected aspects of information security in popular writing, are just as important as Confidentiality. Before any bad faith responses pile up: none of this is to say there are no issues to be found and that generative AI has never ever not once been useful for this. #AI #GenAI #GenerativeAI #AgenticAI #LLMs #SecurityTheater #AiHype #stunt (1) Release of marketing/PR materials
